title: Westland Giftware Kitten Musical Snow Globe 2083 You Are My Sunshine Cat Roses
descriptionText:
Westland Giftware musical water globe, item no. 2083 - a fluffy tabby kitten sitting in the grass among pink roses and cream daisies inside a glass globe with glitter, on a cream resin base sculpted with roses, daisies, lavender sprigs and a purple-beaded scalloped edge. The wind-up music box in the base plays "You Are My Sunshine" (tune printed on the Westland label underneath). Stands about 6 inches tall.

Condition: Pre-owned and displays nicely - glass globe is clear with no chips or cracks, water is clear with glitter, and the painted base has no chips. Original Westland item/tune label and glass warning label still on the bottom. Please see all photos - they are of the actual globe you will receive.
